description: This file implements core autograd logic for PyTorch in C++, including gradient creation, backward execution, and related utilities within the torch::autograd namespace.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: Placeholder class used when an input does not require gradient.

classes.name: ForwardADLevel
classes.description: Manages dual level indices for forward automatic differentiation.

methods.name: variable_list _make_grads(const variable_list & outputs,const variable_list & grad_outputs)

methods.name: void backward(const variable_list & tensors,const variable_list & grad_tensors,std::optional<bool> retain_graph,bool create_graph,const variable_list & inputs)
methods.description: Public API to compute gradients of given tensors.

methods.description: Computes gradients of output tensors w.r.t. inputs, with options for retain_graph and allow_unused.

methods.name: uint64_t enter_dual_level()
methods.description: Enters a new dual level for forward AD.
